Class Recipe

java.lang.Object
Recipe
public class Recipe extends Object
Represents a single recipe, including name, number of servings, list of ingredients, and total calories.

      public void printRecipe()
      Prints the details of the recipe, including name, servings, ingredients, and total calories. Calculates the total calories by summing the calories from all ingredients multiplied by servings.

      public void adjustServings(int newServings)
      Adjusts the ingredient amounts and total calories based on a new number of servings. Scales all ingredient amounts and calories proportionally.
